notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221913/dd43a18e91a0cdcc0fd7652fe5aaca7097acea8b.jpg[/img]

It's St-Patrick's Day! To celebrate the occasion, we are releasing a demo of Shishi : Timeless Prelude on Steam!

[previewyoutube=1FKaD45IyNg;full][/previewyoutube]
In the demo, you will be able to play as Elia and explore two floors of the procedurally generated dungeon. She will be helped by the Passion variant of herself, one of the six characters of the game, specialized in offensive magic. The two of them will have to reach the sanctuary’s final floor, where they will encounter a mysterious character.

Happy St-Patrick's Day!

notes.title: Shishi : Timeless Prelude is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221913/0d2857a17c1cf53df0975840bfc87c4a80468870.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that our first game, Shishi : Timeless Prelude, is coming to Steam!

Available on Nintendo Switch since May 31st, 2022, Shishi : Timeless Prelude is a colorful dungeon role-playing game. As Elia, a young mage, you will explore the depths of a sacred sanctuary to complete your training to become an Oracle.

Chosen by the Goddess, the young Elia is about to start a great adventure to protect the kingdom. However, she must first complete her training. As she explores the Timeless Sanctuary, Elia becomes stronger and learns spells that will be essential to succeed the trial.

Shishi : Timeless Prelude will be available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215340]on Steam[/url] in March 2023.
